discovered_by: Bright, Kotsireas, Ganesh 2020 enumeration of the even orders up to 70; earlier constructions credited there. Enumerated here under equiv-v1 by this board's williamson-even-exact-v1

sources.title: This board's inline enumerator williamson-even-exact-v1, replayed at n=4
Bright, Kotsireas, Ganesh, Applying computer algebra systems with SAT solvers to the Williamson conjecture, J. Symbolic Comput. 100 (2020), Section 2.2 and Table 1

notes: Full census replayed on this board by williamson-even-exact-v1 on every verification: 5 classes under equiv-v1. The published enumeration counts 1 class at this order under a coarser equivalence, which also identifies the cyclic shift of a single block by n/2 and the negation of every second entry of all four blocks. With those two operations added, the classes here fall into 1, the published count.
